To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
smart devices are abandoned when they are perceived to not be beneficial, useful, and/or manageable, and are used when they are perceived as useful, beneficial, and satisfying.

smart devices are used when they satisfy curiosity and are perceived to be useful, are abandoned when they do not fit with conceptions of self, and are perceived as not useful, and are abandoned when device maintenance becomes unmanageable.

smart devices are abandoned due to lack of perceived utility, lack of fit with self, and lack of time to use and maintain devices; and that they are used because they satisfy curiosity, fit with routines, and hold hope for future benefit.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how smart devices fit into the everyday lives of people and how to make these devices more useful and usable.
how users perceive and use smart devices, and how they can be better integrated in everyday life.
how users can benefit from smart devices and how to design for this.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we need to understand the needs, motivations, and desires of users to develop smart sensing devices that will be used and not abandoned.
smart devices are useful, but they are not currently useful for everyone.
the smart devices are not yet ready for the mainstream, but they are not far from it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have to understand the users' goals, needs, and expectations to make smart devices more useful.
we have found that smart devices are used and abandoned for reasons that are similar to the reasons people use and abandon any other device.

Why
The main takeaway from our work is that
smart devices are not a panacea, and their uptake and use are complex and multifaceted.
the design and use of smart sensing devices is not as simple as we would like.
the use of smart devices is complex, and the design of smart devices should be guided by a deep understanding of the user and their context.
